--add-line-nos.name: add_line_nos
--add-line-nos.description: Adds line numbers to the extracted text and saves line metadata, which can be queried later using the highlights API.

--allow-rotated-text.name: allow_rotated_text
--allow-rotated-text.description: Whether to keep words whose own orientation is rotated. With this off, a word angled further than watermark_angle_threshold is treated as a watermark and excluded.

--checkbox-confidence-threshold.name: checkbox_confidence_threshold
--checkbox-confidence-threshold.description: The minimum confidence a detected checkbox mark must have to be reported as marked. Accepts a value in the range [0.0, 1.0].

--derotate-threshold.name: derotate_threshold
--derotate-threshold.description: The page rotation in degrees beyond which the page is straightened and re-read.

--file-name.name: file_name
--file-name.description: The name of the file to store in reports.

--gaussian-blur-radius.name: gaussian_blur_radius
--gaussian-blur-radius.description: The radius of the Gaussian blur.

--ignore-vertical-text.name: ignore_vertical_text
--ignore-vertical-text.description: Whether to drop vertically oriented text instead of extracting it.

--include-line-confidence.name: include_line_confidence
--include-line-confidence.description: Adds line confidence to the line metadata returned by the highlights API. Requires add_line_nos to be enabled.

--line-splitter-tolerance.name: line_splitter_tolerance
--line-splitter-tolerance.description: The line splitter tolerance. This client pins its own default below the service's, and has always sent it, so the two are expected to differ.

--median-filter-size.name: median_filter_size
--median-filter-size.description: The size of the median filter.

--min-table-width.name: min_table_width
--min-table-width.description: The minimum width a table must span, as a fraction of the page width, to be extracted as a table.

--url.name: url
--url.description: Fetch the document from this URL instead of sending a body.

--use-webhook.name: use_webhook
--use-webhook.description: Webhook name to call. If not provided, then no webhook will be called.

--watermark-angle-threshold.name: watermark_angle_threshold
--watermark-angle-threshold.description: The angle in degrees beyond which a rotated word counts as a watermark. Only applies when allow_rotated_text is off.

--webhook-metadata.name: webhook_metadata
--webhook-metadata.description: The webhook metadata. This data will be passed to the webhook if webhooks are used

--word-confidence-threshold.name: word_confidence_threshold
--word-confidence-threshold.description: Minimum per-word OCR confidence to report. Defaults to 0.05 unless the deployment overrides it.

--lines.name: lines
--lines.description: Line numbers or ranges, e.g. `1-5,9`. Required unless `extract_all_lines=true`.

--whisper-hash.name: whisper_hash
--whisper-hash.description: The hash of the whisper operation.

--custom-data.name: custom_data
--custom-data.description: Arbitrary JSON. The service returns it under each result item's ``metadata.custom_data``, which is server behaviour: the spec carries the field on the request only, so the round trip is not declared and nothing here pins it. Anything that is not already a string is serialised to JSON before it is sent.

--hitl-packet-id.name: hitl_packet_id
--hitl-packet-id.description: Groups documents reviewed together into one packet. Requires the enterprise manual-review capability; an installation without it rejects the request with 400.

--hitl-queue-name.name: hitl_queue_name
--hitl-queue-name.description: Document class name for the manual review queue. Requires the enterprise manual-review capability; an installation without it rejects the request with 400.

--llm-profile-id.name: llm_profile_id
--llm-profile-id.description: LLM profile to override the deployment's.

--presigned-urls.name: presigned_urls
--presigned-urls.description: URLs to fetch the inputs from.

--timeout.name: timeout
--timeout.description: Execution mode — ``0`` or below queues the execution and returns immediately; above it the call runs synchronously.

--use-file-history.name: use_file_history
--use-file-history.description: Reuse a previous result for the same file.
